create_softphongshader: create a SoftPhongShader instance with per pixel lighting and soft blending for rendering meshes
create_hardphongshader: create a HardPhongShader instance with per pixel lighting and hard blending for rendering meshes
create_softgouraudshader: create a SoftGouraudShader instance with per vertex lighting and soft blending for rendering meshes
create_hardgouraudshader: create a HardGouraudShader instance with per vertex lighting and hard blending for rendering meshes
create_silhouette_shader: create a SoftSilhouetteShader to render mesh silhouettes using sigmoid alpha blending of top K faces
